content: Conduct a thorough and detailed health assessment to evaluate the individual's overall medical condition and identify any potential health concerns. Assess for the presence of comorbidities, including conditions that may complicate diabetes management or pregnancy outcomes. Perform a complete obstetric and gynecologic evaluation to assess reproductive health and identify any potential risks related to pregnancy. Evaluate thyroid function to identify and address any thyroid disorders, as these can impact both diabetes management and pregnancy outcomes.
